notes.summary: Dhananjay Nautiyal v. State of Uttarakhand, Secretary Finance aur Director (filing 10.08.2026). Court record aur order mein petition ka vishay likha nahi hai. Respondents mein Finance vibhag hai, isliye mamla vetan, bhatte ya bhugtaan se juda ho sakta hai, par yeh andaaza hai, record mein nahi. Aaj item 49 mein iske saath 7 aur WPSS (2355, 2357, 2359, 2404, 2405, 2408, 2409/2026) hain, sab Shobhit Saharia ke aur State ke khilaaf. Ho sakta hai sab ek hi mudde ke hon.
notes.status: 12.08.2026 (Justice Pankaj Purohit): State ki maang par counter affidavit ke liye 6 hafte (lagbhag 23.09.2026 tak). 12.10.2026 ko Justice Rakesh Thapliyal ke saamne item 49.
pros: Counter ki 6 hafte ki seema beet chuki hai. Counter na aaya ho to court ko batana chahiye.
cons: Petition ka vishay aur maang record mein nahi hai. Isliye paksh-vipaksh aur milte-julte faisle abhi nahi jod sakte.
Sirf ek procedural order hai, jisme koi tark ya tathya nahi.
todo: Petition ki copy app mein daalo, uske baad poora vishleshan aur milte-julte faisle
notes.disclaimer: Is case ke court record mein sirf ek procedural order hai, isliye vishleshan seemit hai. Petition milne par paksh-vipaksh aur Supreme Court/HC ke faisle jode jaayenge.
